description: Read one post: where it stands, every slide's text, the caption and hashtags, and the studio link. While it is still being made, pass `wait` (up to 50 seconds) and the answer comes as soon as it is done, or when the wait runs out with `making.status` still `queued` or `running`. A reel also has each scene's `narration` and its `video`: `standing` is missing (not made yet), behind (the video no longer matches the reel: a scene, the voice, the logo, the colors or the @ changed since it was made), current or failed. `tooLong` means the saved narration is estimated to run long in this voice or the take ran over its limit. The answer also gives the re-recordings still included. Only a person makes or updates the video, in the studio at `studioUrl`, after confirming the narration there; no call here makes it. Once the scenes are made, `making` can be a video take a person started there: a failed take shows in `video` too and is never a reason to call create_post again.

profile.description: A profile's handle from list_profiles, or its permanent UUID

wait.description: Seconds to wait for a post still being made

name: get_post
title: Get a post
